records.title: Temperature and decompression sickness
records.note: The New Haven team reports 38 participants and 233 person-flights. Warm and cold conditions reused participants when possible. The percentages for the 23 people completing four or more flights lack the corresponding flight denominators.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 120-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: New Haven experimental chamber series. Chamber held at 100 °F. Ascent at 5,000 ft/min to 38,000 ft. Subjects wore gym clothing and contributed repeated flights.
observations.note: The investigator reports 38 people across both conditions and attempted a balanced exposure order. The exact paired records remain unavailable.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 120-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: New Haven experimental chamber series. Chamber held at 100 °F. Ascent at 5,000 ft/min to 38,000 ft. Subjects wore gym clothing and contributed repeated flights.
observations.note: The narrative supplies a percentage. Exact event counts and a respiratory-specific denominator are unavailable.

observations.note: The comparison uses the subset of 23 people who flew four or more times. Its temperature-specific flight counts are unavailable.

records.title: Repeated exposure and bends incidence
records.note: Forty-two people contributed 209 repeated chamber tests. The 136 incapacitating-symptom descents have an exact denominator. The third-hour fraction is printed only as a rounded percentage of descents.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 180-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: Room-temperature chamber study with 42 participants and repeated man-runs. Pure oxygen from the start of the ascent to 38,000 ft. Standardized activity occurred every ten minutes.
observations.note: The source identifies incapacitating symptoms as the reason for these early descents. Participant-level pairings are unavailable.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 180-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: Room-temperature chamber study with 42 participants and repeated man-runs. Pure oxygen from the start of the ascent to 38,000 ft. Standardized activity occurred every ten minutes.
observations.note: Source-rounded completion percentage. Completion does not establish that the flight was symptom-free.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 180-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: Room-temperature chamber study with 42 participants and repeated man-runs. Pure oxygen from the start of the ascent to 38,000 ft. Standardized activity occurred every ten minutes.
observations.note: Conditional distribution of the 136 early descents. The report gives no exact third-hour event count.

records.title: Summary of data presented at Washington on April 15, 1943
records.note: The report gives 65 participants and 219 man-runs under a modified Pennsylvania exercise test. The symptom groups and consecutive-pass margins overlap. Exercise oxygen consumption was measured at ground pressure and is not linked to individual outcome rows.

observations.outcome_window: During the planned 180-minute target-altitude test or symptom-driven termination.
observations.protocol: Modified Pennsylvania exercise test with staged ascent to 38,000 ft and oxygen from the start of ascent. Exercise at altitude included repeated rises, a knee bend and lifting tasks.
observations.note: Reported percentage. The 47-subject group may be nested within the 65-person overall series. Joint symptom counts are not supplied.
